name: leo-logs-workspace
description: Leo Logs workspace: OpenRouter logs for pipelines and agents.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @leo-logs/trace && npm run build -w @leo-logs/ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @leo-logs/trace && npm run typecheck -w @leo-logs/ui && tsc -p examples/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.leo-logs: npm run build -w @leo-logs/trace && node --import tsx packages/ui/src/bin.ts
scripts.ui: npm run build -w @leo-logs/trace && node --import tsx packages/ui/src/bin.ts ui
scripts.example: npm run build -w @leo-logs/trace && node --import tsx examples/calls.ts
